cues.title: Warm conversational onset
cues.text: Enter at speaking weight right around C4. Keep the throat open and let the breath move gently through 'fire' without glottal attack.

cues.fragment: I don't want to wait, she saw the flowers blooming up
cues.title: Connect the 9.7-semitone lift
cues.text: As the line climbs to E4 on 'blooming up', keep your vowel narrow so the upper chest-mix stays buoyant rather than heavy.

cues.fragment: Telling me how winter sucks for you
cues.title: Sustain & release into vibrato
cues.text: Highest sustain passage in Verse 1 (89% voiced continuity, 53% vibrato on 'what more that I can do'). Hold steady rib support and let vibrato shimmer at the end.

cues.fragment: We've worked so hard to be where we be
cues.title: Float the F4 turn cleanly
cues.text: Spans 9.5 semitones up to F4 before settling back into chest on 'right now'. Lighten the vocal fold mass before the top note.

cues.title: Flip effortlessly into head-mix on 'lily'
cues.text: Spans 11.2 semitones up to G#4 (MIDI 67.8) on 'lily from the valley'. Let the larynx stay neutral as you release into head voice.

cues.title: Second marigold variation (A4 peak)
cues.text: The second repeat reaches A4 (MIDI 69.0) with fast R&B agility. Aim the vowel forward behind the upper teeth rather than pushing air.

cues.fragment: Girl give it up, give it up, give it up, give it up, this year
cues.title: Rhythmic bounce & legato release
cues.text: Keep the repeated 'give it up' phrases light and percussive from the diaphragm, then let 'don't let it hurt' settle into warm vibrato (59% vibrato ratio).

cues.title: Articulate rapid floral phrasing
cues.text: Keep tongue and lip diction crisp on the syncopated sixteenth-note syllables while maintaining a steady low-chest anchor.

cues.fragment: If that makes you happy then I'll be
cues.title: Crest the B4 head-voice peak ('Happy too')
cues.text: Song's widest leap (12.9 semitones) and highest note (B4, MIDI 71.8) on 'Happy too'. Release completely into pure, weightless head voice.

cues.fragment: Girl give it up, give it up, give it up, give it up, this year
cues.title: Ride the final chorus home
cues.text: Keep energy buoyant through the final 'keep you warm till spring comes' (10.4-semitone range) and taper the closing note with relaxed breath.
